component.name: SM64Coin Wallet
component.summary: SM64Coin: the cryptocurrency you mine by playing Super Mario 64

description.p: SM64Coin is a private digital currency, forked from Monero, whose proof of work is playing Super Mario 64. There is no hash mining: blocks are produced by playing the game, one block about every five minutes. Mined coins unlock after 10 blocks.
Your wallet has a 25 word mnemonic seed that is only displayed once, and can be written down to backup the wallet. Wallet files are encrypted with a passphrase to ensure they are useless if stolen.
